# c11 — SUYU-GURecomp facts vs. MHGU 1.4.0 disassembly

Source: SUYU-GURecomp commit 35015f1, `game_settings.cpp` (PIAPROBE text handling). Address convention: SUYU "main+X" equals our vaddr X.

| vaddr | meaning | SUYU cite | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x131c3e0 | Entry point of a routine that receives/parses one PIAPROBE text message; SUYU cites it as the reader called from the receive path | game_settings.cpp:1493 | VERIFIED | `push {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, lr}` + `sub sp, sp, #184` — standard AAPCS prologue saving callee-saved registers and carving a 184-byte frame, followed by argument shuffling `mov r8, r0` / `mov r6, r2` / `mov r5, r1`, so this is a real function entry, not mid-function |
| 0x139dce4 | Entry point of the receive loop that drives the PIAPROBE message flow | game_settings.cpp:1494 | VERIFIED | `push {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, lr}` + `sub sp, sp, #28`; then `mov r10, r0` caches the context pointer and `ldr r0, [r10, #8]` loads the first member before `bl 0x139edec` — function entry with a 28-byte frame |
| 0x139e5f8 | Entry point of the message iterator used by the receive loop: asks the message source whether another message is available, then walks them | game_settings.cpp:1494 | VERIFIED | `push {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, lr}` + `sub sp, sp, #132`; then `mov r4, r0` / `ldr r0, [r4, #0]` / `ldr r1, [r0, #44]` / `blx r1` (virtual call on the source) and `cmp r0, #0` / `bne 0x139e81c` — entry + early-exit check, consistent with an iterator whose first action probes availability |
